gui.ae2_gvt.world.tip.decay: Decays into a fluix block in the end
gui.ae2_gvt.world.scene.drop: Turns into something else on a hole
gui.ae2_gvt.world.scene.blast: Turns into something else when caught together in an explosion
gui.ae2_gvt.world.title: World Interactions
gui.ae2_gvt.world.entangled_singularity: Caught in an explosion together: 2 a set
gui.ae2_gvt.world.black_hole_growth: Feed it items; buds grow round it
gui.ae2_gvt.world.white_hole_growth: Feed it items; buds grow round it
gui.ae2_gvt.world.paradox_seed: Use on fluix between the two holes
gui.ae2_gvt.world.budding_paradox: Grows buds, then decays to fluix
ae2_gvt.tool.title: Right-click tool
ae2_gvt.tool.hint: Once every material is in, the machine is right-clicked with it
ae2_gvt.sub_machines.title: Sub-machines
ae2_gvt.sub_machines.order: Materials set to go to sub-machines
ae2_gvt.sub_machines.order2: go in this order, one full then the next.
ae2_gvt.sub_machines.hint: Put an item in; empty hand clears
ae2_gvt.pattern.role.hint.normal: An ordinary material: every run uses it up
ae2_gvt.pattern.role.hint.catalyst: Not used up: stays in the machine for the whole batch and is taken back when it is done
ae2_gvt.pattern.gui_slot.hint: Slot: 0 (shown as -) = the first slot that takes it; 1 and up = the machine's hatch numbered N if one is bound, else the Nth slot of the machine's GUI (not the player's inventory), for machines that take items only in a GUI
ae2_gvt.pattern.gui_slot_out.hint: GUI slot to take from: 0 (shown as -) = a result slot (one that takes nothing); 1 and up = the Nth slot of the machine's GUI (not the player's inventory)
ae2_gvt.jei.sequence_pattern: Make a sequence pattern: one item in each place of the recipe, with that place's slot
ae2_gvt.jei.sequence_pattern.no_terminal: Make a sequence pattern (open the twin-star pattern terminal first)
ae2_gvt.sequence_start.hint: The GUI slot of the machine the first slot of a sequence pattern goes into (2 when the machine's output is its first slot). Remembered per machine
ae2_gvt.sequence_dialog.title: Make a sequence pattern
ae2_gvt.pattern.target.hint.machine: Into the main block; one with no item access gets it by a right-click
ae2_gvt.pattern.target.hint.sub: Into the sub-machines near the main block, in their order, one full then the next. The range is set on the machine access interface
ae2_gvt.pattern.target.hint.front: Into the cell in front of the main block's opening; products are picked up there
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.sub_range_on: Within %s blocks of the machine, 1 up and down; they get FE from the network too
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.sub_range_cli: Left click: one more; right click: one less
ae2_gvt.pattern.target.hint.default: With sub-machines set: the first material into the main block, the rest into the sub-machines; else all into the main block
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.pulse_on: On: a pulse into the machine once a run's materials are all in
ae2_gvt.pattern.ignore_nbt.input: Any stack of the same item will do, whatever its enchantments, name or other data; not one of another durability
ae2_gvt.pattern.ignore_nbt.output: The same item out of the machine counts as this product, whatever its data
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.blocking_full: Full blocking: one run at a time, the next once its materials are used up
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.blocking_resu: Wait for result: one run at a time, the next once anything comes back out of the machine
ae2_gvt.pattern.refused.no_machine: No machine set: the pattern cannot be encoded
ae2_gvt.pattern.uploaded: Encoded and uploaded to the hub
ae2_gvt.pattern.upload_same: The hub has this pattern already: it stays in the slot
ae2_gvt.pattern.upload_full: The hub has no room: the pattern stays in the slot
ae2_gvt.pattern.refused.not_recipe: Not a recipe of this block: the pattern cannot be encoded
message.ae2_gvt.space_elevator.unknown: Space elevator: structure not loaded, place the controller again
message.ae2_gvt.space_elevator.pending: Space elevator: not finished. Wrong cells: %s
message.ae2_gvt.space_elevator.built: Built the space elevator: %s blocks, controller at %s
message.ae2_gvt.space_elevator.cleared: Took down the space elevator: removed %s blocks (controller was at %s)
message.ae2_gvt.space_elevator.too_high: The space elevator is 319 tall: starting at Y=%s it leaves the world. Its bottom can be at most Y=%s
message.ae2_gvt.space_elevator.not_contr: %s is not a space elevator controller
tooltip.ae2_gvt.link_tool.usage: Sneak + right-click a machine access interface to pick it; right-click machines to link them (again to unlink), many per interface; sneak + right-click the air to unpick. While held, the interface and its machines glow and are joined by lines
message.ae2_gvt.link_tool.removed: Machine unlinked (%s, %s, %s); this interface has %s left
message.ae2_gvt.link_tool.no_interface: Sneak + right-click the machine access interface to set up first
message.ae2_gvt.link_tool.other_dimensio: The machine is in another dimension; wireless cannot cross dimensions
message.ae2_gvt.link_tool.limit: One interface links at most %s machines
tooltip.ae2_gvt.link_tool.ctrl: Ctrl + right-click a machine: links every block of the same kind around it at once (within 16 blocks, up to 64 machines by default; both are in the config). It only adds; to unlink one, right-click it alone
message.ae2_gvt.link_tool.added_all: Linked %s x %s within %s blocks; this interface has %s
message.ae2_gvt.link_tool.all_cut: %s more of the same kind were left out (the limit of one click, or no room left in this interface)
message.ae2_gvt.link_tool.all_already: No unlinked %s within %s blocks (all linked, or out of wireless range)
message.ae2_gvt.machine_access.same_none: No other machine of the same kind is listed
message.ae2_gvt.machine_access.same_appl: The optional machine was set on %s other machines of the same kind
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.apply_same: Apply to all machines of the same kind
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.apply_same_de: Gives the %s other machines of the same kind as this one the optional machine set here (an empty slot too). Their cells in the list show it as a small icon in the corner
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.apply_same_hi: The number is how many of the same kind are listed, this one included
message.ae2_gvt.machine_access.remove_co: Press again within 5 seconds to remove %s listed blocks (machines and their hatches)
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.remove.marked: Takes out the machines you marked with Shift + click (the selected one when none is marked), with their hatches
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.remove.same: Remove all machines of the same kind
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.remove.same.d: Takes out every listed machine that is the same block as the selected one, with their hatches
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.remove.all.de: Lets go of every machine and hatch listed here
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.mark_hint: Shift + click marks it for removal
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.edit_same.sin: A setting you change only applies to the selected machine
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.edit_same.tog: Machines of the same kind together

A setting you change (blocking, insert mode, pairing, range, redstone, optional machine, recovery, stock) is written to every listed machine of the same kind. Hatches, roles and slot numbers stay as they are
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.edit_same_hin: Click to switch. Saved with the interface
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.mode.provider: The hub sends patterns' materials into the machines and takes products back; each machine has its own settings
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.mode.interfac: Keeps the configured items in each machine; the hub does not use these machines
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.cell_hint: Click to select, double click to light it up in the world
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.gear_hint: Left click: set the limit. Shift + left click: this cell shows everything the network has and the slot above writes no amount; again to go back
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.craft.running: The crafting card asked the network to craft what this stock is short of. Nothing more is asked for this item until it is done
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.craft.retry_d: No pattern, missing materials or no free crafting CPU. It tries again later, waiting longer each time (5 minutes at most)
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.recover_on: On: takes what the machine gives out back into the network (except the items it keeps)
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.recover_face_: Off: does not take from this face
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.recover_faces: Opens a panel where any number of faces can be picked: lit cells are taken back from
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.state.slave: Linked to the master, uses the whole network's channels
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.state.two_masters: More than one master on this frequency
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.state.failed: Link failed, waiting for the other side to load
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.role.off.desc: An ordinary ME controller. Click to change.
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.role.master.desc: The main of this frequency's network, one per frequency. Click to change.
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.role.slave.desc: Links to the master of the same frequency and uses the whole network's channels. Click to change.
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.frequency_hint: Pick any name: controllers with the same name link up
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.none_in_use: No frequency yet, type one above
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.row_conflict: More than one master on this frequency: the network conflicts
gui.ae2_gvt.quantum.row_no_master: This frequency has no master yet
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.recover_energ: On: the FE a machine gives out goes into the network (click to turn off)
Off: the machine's FE is left alone (click to turn on)
A machine of its own, run by the hub with its patterns; the hatches after it in the list belong to it, up to the next machine
An item input of the machine before it: a pattern's slot N goes into the hatch numbered N, nowhere else
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.role.fluid_in: A fluid hatch of the machine before it: a fluid with a slot goes into that number, one without into the first hatch that takes it
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.role.output.d: The products of the machine before it are taken out of this block
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.role.energy.d: Gets the FE the network sends
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.role_click: Left click: next; right click: previous
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.slot_auto: Automatic: by its place among this machine's hatches of its kind, now %s
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.slot_set: Set by hand to %s (a line under the number)
gui.ae2_gvt.machine_access.slot_click: Left click: one more; right click: one less; Shift: ten at a time; down to 0 is automatic
item.ae2_gvt.dispatch_marker.tooltip: Not a real item. A pattern names it as its product to count as finished once its materials are in the machine. It never reaches the network.
ae2_gvt.pattern.done.tip: The run counts as finished (and this product as made) once all its materials are in the machine. The job does not wait for the product to come back; for machines whose product leaves by itself. Later steps cannot count on it.
ae2_gvt.pattern.done.marker: A marker always counts as made once the materials are in.
ae2_gvt.pattern.marker.tip: Replaces this product with the dispatch marker (not a real item, hidden from JEI / EMI): the run is finished once its materials are in the machine, and later steps of the order can follow it.
